text:
alex (eng): Hey team — planning to relocate from CA -> TX in mid-Aug. How does this affect my WFH stipend, payroll withholding, and benefits? Also curious if Redwood covers any relocation assistance or if I need to run this through my manager first. :wave:
jaya (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: High-level: 1) WFH stipend: prorated for the month you move, submitted via the Expense form. 2) Payroll/tax: moving states may change state tax withholding and could create a tax nexus for Redwood; we need 2 weeks notice so payroll can update. 3) Benefits: most benefits follow employment location — some provider networks vary by state, but coverage continues. 4) Relocation assistance: limited, case-by-case — we have a relocation policy for senior roles. Start with manager + People Ops.

Could you confirm your exact move date and whether you'll remain US-based or go international?
alex (eng): ETA Aug 15. Staying US-based. I'm on monthly WFH stipend ($100/mo) and had 8 days PTO left. Do I need to submit anything now? :thinking:
jaya (People Ops): For a US-internal move: please do the following ASAP:
1) Fill the Move Notice form: https://intranet.redwood/company/move-notice (this triggers payroll + IT workflows)
2) Expense claim for WFH as usual; we prorate the month you move. Example: move on Aug 15 => you keep 50% of Aug stipend.
3) Update your home address in Self-Serve (PeopleOps -> Personal Info) — this auto-notifies benefits admin.
4) Tell your manager so they can approve any relocation assistance request.

I'll paste the expense calc snippet you can use:
```
prorated_stipend = round(monthly_stipend * (days_in_state_before_move / days_in_month), 2)
```

Also: please opt into the "Move Checklist" Slack thread so IT can set up new region VPN rules.
carlos (Legal): Quick legal note — if you change your permanent work state to TX, we will stop withholding CA state income tax and start TX (TX has no state income tax). That is straightforward. However, please be aware of local city taxes if applicable. If anyone moves internationally, escalate to Legal early (minimum 30 days) — cross-border hires trigger immigration and local labor law checks.
maya (Finance): Payroll timeline: we need address updated in the system by payroll cutoff (2 weeks before your move) to effect changes for the next pay run. If we miss the cutoff, changes apply the following cycle and we may issue reconciliation. For stipend proration, submit the expense within 30 days of the move.
payroll-bot: Reminder — address change request queued for alex (eng). To cancel or edit, run `/payroll address` within 72h.
alex (eng): Awesome, thanks. One more: does health insurance plan network change require open enrollment or mid-year change? :moneybag:
jaya (People Ops): Mid-year address change does not force plan change. Most medical plans allow you to stay on the same plan if offered in the new state; in rare cases network availability forces a change — we'll notify you if that happens. Any change to premiums or options will be communicated by Benefits within 10 business days after address update.
alex (eng): Great — I'll submit the Move Notice today and ping my manager. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
